title: Favorites
intro: Your wishlist: products you want next time, stalls you go back to, and the markets you shop at. A sold-out favorite tells you when it is back.

filters.emptyText: Try a different filter to see the rest of your saved products.

holdNote: Saving a product does not hold any stock. It is held only when you place the order.
stallsNote: Your saved stalls, with the markets each one sells at.
marketsNote: A saved market comes first in lists and on the map, and directions to its stalls start from your saved address.

products.title: No saved products yet
products.text: Save a product from its page to find it here, with a restock alert if it ever sells out.

stalls.title: No saved stalls yet
stalls.text: Save a stall from its page to keep it here for next time.

markets.title: No saved markets yet
markets.text: Save a market from its page to keep it here for next time.
